info.name: Cypher API
info.description: Requests for every Cypher endpoint. Run the folders top to bottom (or the whole collection with Collection Runner): each Create request saves the new id to a collection variable, later requests use it, and the Cleanup folder deletes everything it created. Set base_url via the Cypher Local environment (default http://localhost:8000).
